testcase.name: per-monitor realtime quotes five personal slots and sends only an explicit top-level mode with revision and expected cost

an eligible-sounding plan does not bypass server denied realtime or create a one-slot quote

acquiring a one-slot benefit keeps five reserved slots until an explicit same-mode reapply

rapid save clicks issue one request and a response after the view is left cannot announce success or overwrite parent data
an old reload finishing after inactive/reactive transitions cannot release the price conflict gate
an undefined parent read result does not count as a verified price refresh

a username alone creates an owner-bound X target with existing destinations/rules and no numeric ID input

registration capacity rejection retains input and a failed refresh never exposes internal exceptions

quality/interval follow current paid plan even when free/supporter/special assignment changes
inactive X views do not fetch or write, and a late fetch after leaving cannot replace current owner data
rapid register clicks write once and use only the returned canonical monitor after commit
existing private monitor workspace exposes lazy X controls while guild-shared scope has no personal owner panel
a free vacancy does not mutate another assignment; owner can manually choose a later eligible pool
manual move denial keeps the selected pool and suspension visibly retains pool/personal occupation
a stale manual move retains selection and requires refreshed CAS confirmation
cadence boost consumption is separate from actual registration count and still exhausts physical personal capacity
private workspace on a guild page links to personal setup without using the guild-bound setup API
an owner selects a stored receiver explicitly for a target and multiple authors can share that receiver
binding edit preserves notifications and revision, while owner rejection retains chosen receiver
a target without a receiver remains visibly pending and a listening receiver never claims successful delivery
rollout denial blocks create and resume even against stale enabled quota and preserves stop/delete/edit
failed setup metadata blocks new receiver selection and registration without losing existing binding on ordinary edits
the compact X tab opens monitoring directly with actual quota and timing summaries and a dedicated connection link

a repeated shared-entry request resumes an existing X draft without replacing its fields or review
shared-entry requests keep capacity checks and permit the existing unbound pending registration only when eligible
new registrations default explicitly to batch when monitor-level quotes are available and never inherit realtime accidentally
new realtime registration displays and confirms its exact five-slot cost before a top-level mode and cost are sent

malformed, ineligible and unavailable supporter offers never infer a direct registration right
a directly registered supporter monitor can later switch notification methods and edit its destination without implicit pool movement
a one-slot supporter or plan quote is used as returned, while denied or missing metadata never fabricates realtime permission

editing a name or destination preserves per-monitor realtime allocation without including a mode mutation
a shared registration can hide the duplicate X action and inherit only a fresh draft name and destination

a manual pool change discloses realtime requalification and renders the actual returned timing without reserving extra slots
usage displays one notification plan for native and X and counts registrations, boosts and permanent additions
paid plan names do not imply realtime or replace server-provided special capacities

missing plan interval shows administrator configuration as the next step without a purchase action

personal capacity, shared capacity and beta eligibility offer distinct next actions
